title: DropWheel tool manifest
description: tool.json for a user tool in %LOCALAPPDATA%\DropWheel\tools\<slug>\. See skills/dropwheel-tool/SKILL.md and docs/adr/0005-user-tools-manifest-and-trust.md.

id.description: Unique across the tools folder. Becomes the operation id DropWheel records in jobs.

hint.description: One line shown in the wheel's centre while hovering.

icon.description: A Segoe Fluent Icons code point such as E7A7, drawn above the name. Anything else is a warning and the sector shows no icon.

appliesTo.description: Omit or null for every kind of file, including unknown files and folders.

kind.description: script runs a process; recipe runs built-in items in turn and needs steps instead of script.

steps.description: Recipe only. Each step's outputs are the next step's inputs; only the last step writes where the user's outputs go.

command.description: Absolute path, a path relative to the tool folder, or a bare name found in the tool folder or on PATH (PATHEXT applies). pwsh falls back to Windows PowerShell with a warning.

args.description: Passed as is, no shell. Placeholders: {input} {inputs} {output} {outputDir} {toolDir}. {output} and {outputDir} need output.mode new-file; {input} needs perFile true, {inputs} needs perFile false.

suffix.description: Appended to the source's stem; no characters Windows forbids in file names.

placement.description: A hint applied once, when the tool is first seen; afterwards layout.json rules.

op.description: A built-in item that writes files without asking: tool.compress-image, tool.half-size, tool.rotate-right, tool.strip-metadata, tool.combine-pdf, tool.merge-pdf, tool.split-pdf, tool.ocr, tool.compress-video, tool.extract-audio, tool.mute, tool.extract, action.zip. Never user.* nor another recipe.

convert.description: A target of the Convert wheel by extension, such as jpg or pdf. Takes no options; set appliesTo when it is the first step.

options.description: Only with op. compress-image: quality 1..100; half-size: percent 1..100; rotate-right: degrees 90 / 180 / 270. Others take none.
